**Asia Stocks Fall for Fourth Day Amid US Chip Curbs**
Asian equities declined for a fourth consecutive session alongside falling oil prices. According to the source RSS data, the drop comes as US moves to restrict China's access to advanced artificial intelligence chips and servers heighten market caution. Investors are also preparing for upcoming high-stakes earnings from Nvidia Corp. This summary is based strictly on provided RSS text; the full article was not fetched and this represents a single source without independent confirmation.
